name: Pizzeria Massimo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Massimo in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! **Pizzeria Massimo** invites you to savor delicious pizzas, fresh pasta, and fine wines in a cozy atmosphere. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Diavola**, every bite is a taste of Italy. Located in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, this pizzeria combines traditional recipes with local ingredients, creating unforgettable dining experiences. Don’t miss their handmade **Tiramisu**—the perfect sweet finish to your meal. Come for the food, stay for the warmth!
